items.exampleEn: The baby is crying for attention.
The photo was the only evidence.
items.exampleZh: 那張照片是唯一的證據。

items.exampleEn: There is a wide choice of food at the market.
items.exampleZh: 市場上的食物有很多選擇。

items.exampleEn: Kids often wonder why the sky is blue.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們常常好奇天空為什麼是藍色的。

items.sentenceEn: Please pay attention to the teacher.

items.audioEn: I wonder why the shop is closed today.
items.audioZh: 我在想這家店今天為什麼沒開。

items.sentenceEn: You have two choices: tea or coffee.
items.sentenceZh: 你有兩個選擇：茶或咖啡。

items.sentenceEn: Thank you for your thoughts on my story.
items.sentenceZh: 謝謝你對我的故事提出想法。

items.stemEn: Studying abroad is a great ____ to learn a new language.
items.stemZh: 出國留學是學習新語言的好機會。

items.stemEn: The police have no ____ that he stole the car.
items.stemZh: 警方沒有證據證明是他偷了車。

items.passageEn: Last year, my sister got an opportunity to study abroad. It was a hard choice for her. My parents' biggest concern was money, and she also wondered if she would feel lonely. She thought about it for weeks. In the end, she decided to go. Now she is at a university in Canada, and she says it was the right choice. Her teachers there pay a lot of attention to every student.
items.passageZh: 去年，我的姊妹得到一個出國留學的機會。這對她來說是個困難的選擇。爸媽最大的擔心是錢，她自己也在想會不會覺得孤單。她考慮了好幾個星期，最後決定出國。現在她在加拿大的一所大學念書，她說那是正確的選擇。那裡的老師對每個學生都很關注。

questions.questionZh: 爸媽最大的擔心是什麼？
作者的姊妹現在在哪裡？

referenceEn: You have to make a choice.
You need to make a choice.
rubricZh: 「做出選擇」可寫例如 make a choice

items.promptZh: 我媽媽想知道你明天會不會來。
referenceEn: My mother wonders if you will come tomorrow.
My mom wonders if you are coming tomorrow.
rubricZh: 用 wonder 表示「想知道」，時態可用現在式或現在進行式（例如 wonders、is wondering 等）
「會不會」可寫，例如 if you will come、if you are coming 等
